pages.text: As cities grew larger, people began inventing new tools to make life easier.
One important invention was the printing press. It made copying books much faster.
Before the printing press, books were copied by hand, which took a very long time.
Soon, more people could read books because they became easier to make.
The steam engine used heated water to create power that moved machines and trains.
Steam-powered trains carried goods and people across long distances.
Later, the light bulb brought safe electric light into homes.
Instead of candles, families could turn on a switch for light.
The telephone allowed voices to travel across wires, connecting people far away.
Each invention changed daily life and helped the world become more connected.
